title: Nysgjerrig på hvordan ting fungerer
shortDescription: Åpnet radiobiler for å se hvordan de var laget. Pappa var den største inspirasjonskilden, og interessen ble til studiet jeg tar i dag.

en.title: Curious about how things work
en.label: Curiosity
en.shortDescription: Opened up radio-controlled cars to see how they were made. My dad was the biggest source of inspiration, and the interest became the degree I study today.
